nasa_coolr_events.notes: Current NASA Earthdata COOLR event service; paginated and spatially filtered to NER.

nasa_coolr_reports.notes: Current NASA Earthdata COOLR report-level point observations; availability checked at run time.

worldcover_2021.notes: 10 m land-cover COG tiles; tile discovery/download is generated from AOI.

soilgrids_2.notes: Global 250 m soil property maps and uncertainty; selected properties are configured separately.

hydrobasins_asia.notes: HydroBASINS Asia levels 1-12; official server may reject automated requests with 403 and is treated as optional until successfully acquired.

hydrorivers_asia.notes: HydroRIVERS Asia; official server may reject automated requests with 403 and is treated as optional until successfully acquired.

open_meteo_archive.notes: Historical hourly/daily meteorology used for reproducible event-time histories.

nasa_power.notes: Daily meteorology/precipitation API for independent rainfall cross-checks.

gpm_imerg.notes: Research/NRT precipitation; Earthdata authentication is required for archive downloads.

era5_land.notes: 1950-present hourly reanalysis; CDS credentials required for programmatic bulk access.

copernicus_dem.notes: Copernicus DEM policy/access portal; public AWS mirrors are used where permitted and verified.

sentinel_1.notes: SAR observations; Data Space account/token required for automated catalogue/download.

sentinel_2.notes: Optical observations; Data Space account/token required for automated catalogue/download.

isro_bhuvan_landslide.notes: ISRO/NRSC Landslide Atlas and seasonal/event inventories; portal/API availability checked at run time.
